phases.description: Player hits a mechanical wall (e.g., query volume overwhelms manual clicks). Frustration and friction build.
Player unlocks a new subsystem (e.g., RAM Caching or Governor bypass).
Immediate relief. The system runs beautifully and automatically for a brief period. Player feels powerful.
The newly unlocked efficiency causes the query volume to scale exponentially, creating a new, larger bottleneck. The cycle repeats.
